verdict: Purchases stalled this week; creative refresh is already underway.
narrative: Over the last 28 days your Meta ads delivered 32 purchases on $1,443 in spend, producing a 5.44x return on ad spend — a solid base. However, the final days of this week tell a sharper story: purchases dropped 63.64% and return on ad spend fell 46.68% week-over-week, with zero purchases recorded on July 29–31. The subscription box campaign, which carries 55% of your total spend, has shown the clearest signs of audience fatigue — the same creative reaching the same people too many times. Ad creative is being refreshed this week to break the fatigue cycle, and spend concentration will be redistributed across campaigns. You should expect purchase volume to stabilise and begin recovering once the new creative is in-market, typically within the first few days of rotation.
